title: Wedding website content
description: Everything guests see on the wedding website. Edited through the visual editor.

image.title: Image
image.description: A photo with alt text and a focal point.

src.title: Image file
src.description: Path to the full-size image, for example assets/couple-1.jpg.

alt.title: Alt text
alt.description: A short description for screen readers. Use an empty string only for purely decorative images.

focal.title: Focal point
focal.description: Percent from the left and from the top that must stay visible when the image is cropped.

pageConfig.title: Page
pageConfig.description: Visibility and position of one page.

enabled.title: Show this page
enabled.description: Turn off to hide the page from the menu.

id.title: Identifier
id.description: Short unique id, lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Used in links; do not change once shared.

_note.title: Developer note
_note.description: Internal note; never shown to guests.

site.title: Site settings
site.description: Names, date and contact details used across the site.

title.title: Site title
title.description: Shown in the browser tab and when the link is shared.

couple.title: Couple
couple.description: The two names on the invitation.

initials.title: Initials
initials.description: Short monogram, for example P A.

timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.description: IANA time zone of the venues, for example America/Toronto.

weddingDate.title: Wedding ceremony start
weddingDate.description: Local date and time of the ceremony. The home countdown counts down to this moment.

dateText.title: Date as written
dateText.description: How the date appears on the invitation, for example July 25th, 2027.

city.title: City
city.description: Shown on the home page under the dates, e.g. Edmonton, Canada.

rsvpEndpoint.title: RSVP endpoint
rsvpEndpoint.description: Google Apps Script web app URL. Leave empty for demo mode.

siteUrl.title: Website address
siteUrl.description: Public address of this site; used by the QR code and share links.

ogImage.title: Share preview image
ogImage.description: Image shown when the link is shared in messages.

nameLookup.title: Find invitation by name
nameLookup.description: Let guests find their invitation by typing their name. Off: only the personal link opens a household, so nobody who merely knows a name can change that household's RSVP.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.description: People guests can message for help.

phone.title: Phone number
phone.description: Include the country code, for example +1 416 555 0142.

whatsapp.title: Uses WhatsApp
whatsapp.description: Show a WhatsApp button for this contact.

pages.title: Pages
pages.description: Turn pages on or off and set their order in the menu.

photo.title: Envelope photo
photo.description: The photo that slides out of the envelope.

small.title: Opening line
small.description: Text above the names. A new line starts a new row.

celebrationSmall.title: Opening line (not invited to the wedding)
celebrationSmall.description: Text above the names for guests who are not invited to the wedding itself, e.g. "Please join us for the wedding celebrations of". A new line starts a new row.

venueLines.title: Venue lines
venueLines.description: Not shown on the card any more: the card shows the City instead, since not every guest is invited to the wedding.

items.title: Line
items.description: One line of the venue address.

welcome.title: Welcome message
welcome.description: A short greeting shown on the home page.

board.title: Invitation board labels
board.description: The small words on the flat-lay: the Respond tag and a handwritten note.

respondLabel.title: Respond tag
respondLabel.description: Text on the tag that opens the RSVP page. Default: Respond.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.description: One or two sentences under the Schedule heading.

events.title: Events
events.description: Every event of the wedding weekend. Always shown in date order.

subtitle.title: Tagline
subtitle.description: One short line under the name.

start.title: Starts
start.description: Local start date and time at the venue.

end.title: Ends
end.description: Local end date and time at the venue.

dayPart.title: Time of day
dayPart.description: Morning, afternoon or evening. Shown as a label on the schedule even when the exact clock time is still to be confirmed.

timezone.title: Time zone override
timezone.description: Only if this event is in a different time zone from the site.

mapsQuery.title: Map search text
mapsQuery.description: Text used to search maps if the street address is not specific enough.

notes.title: Venue notes
notes.description: Anything else guests should know about the venue.

title.title: Dress code headline
title.description: For example Festive Indian or cocktail.

text.title: Dress code details
text.description: A sentence or two explaining the dress code.

showSwatches.title: Show colours on the schedule
showSwatches.description: Turn off to hide the colour dots while keeping the palette for later.

notes.title: Good to know
notes.description: Short notices such as Phone-free ceremony.

visibility.title: Who can see it
visibility.description: Public events are visible to everyone. Private events are only shown to invited households.

rsvp.title: Collect RSVPs
rsvp.description: Ask guests whether they will attend this event.

type.title: Hotel type
type.description: Block hotels have a reserved group rate; nearby hotels do not.

recommended.title: Recommended
recommended.description: Highlight this hotel as our top pick.

bookingUrl.title: Booking link
bookingUrl.description: Link to the group booking page.

groupCode.title: Group code
groupCode.description: Code guests mention or enter when booking.

bookBy.title: Book by
bookBy.description: Last day to get the group rate.

driveMinutes.title: Drive times
driveMinutes.description: Optional manual drive times in minutes, by event id. Overrides the automatic estimate.

travel.title: Travel
travel.description: Getting to and around the wedding.

driveMinutes.title: Drive time
driveMinutes.description: Minutes by car to the main venue.

gettingAround.title: Getting around
gettingAround.description: Rideshare, rental car and transit advice.

departs.title: Departure times
departs.description: When it leaves for the event.

text.title: Details
text.description: Entry requirements such as the Canada eTA.

aroundTown.title: Around town
aroundTown.description: Things to see and eat nearby.

category.title: Category
category.description: For example See, Eat or Relax.

teaser.title: Teaser
teaser.description: One line shown to invite people to read more.

paragraphs.title: Story paragraphs
paragraphs.description: The story, one paragraph per item.

people.title: Wedding party
people.description: Optional. The page is hidden while this list is empty.

items.title: Person
items.description: One member of the wedding party.

side.title: Side
side.description: Which side of the family or friends.

bio.title: Bio
bio.description: A line or two about them.

paragraphs.title: Message
paragraphs.description: Text about gifts, one paragraph per item.

links.title: Registry links
links.description: Where guests can find the registry.

category.title: Category
category.description: Id of the category this question belongs to.

q.title: Question
q.description: The question as guests would ask it.

deadlineText.title: Reply-by wording
deadlineText.description: How the deadline is written, for example June 1st, 2027.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.description: Opening text, one paragraph per item.

mealOptions.title: Meal choices
mealOptions.description: Meal options guests can choose from.

hotel.title: Hotel question
hotel.description: Asks whether guests need a hotel.

shuttle.title: Shuttle question
shuttle.description: Asks how many shuttle seats are needed.
